# Mantel

> Mantel is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later), controller-first game launcher for Windows handhelds such as the ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X. It is a console-style home screen that puts every installed game (Steam, Xbox / Game Pass / Microsoft Store, Epic Games, GOG, Ubisoft Connect and any other .exe) on one fullscreen shelf you drive with a gamepad. Games still launch through their own stores, so nothing gets reinstalled or reconfigured.

Mantel is built on and for the ROG Xbox Ally X and should work on any 64-bit Windows handheld (ROG Ally, Lenovo Legion Go, MSI Claw and others) or a TV PC. It ships as a Windows installer (`Mantel_x.y.z_x64-setup.exe`) on GitHub Releases and updates itself from its Settings. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run (More info → Run anyway); signing is coming through SignPath Foundation.

Key facts:

- Finds installed games on first launch, with no plugins and no per-store setup.
- Every screen works with a gamepad, the touchscreen or a keyboard. The control center sets volume and brightness, shows Wi-Fi and battery, closes games, restarts or powers off the device.
- Times every play session; with Steam or Xbox accounts connected it also brings in playtime from all devices, shows achievements (rarity, gamerscore) and lists owned games that aren't installed.
- Xbox and Steam tabs hold the user's games, the PC Game Pass catalog and each store's lists by genre, and search reaches both stores. Buying happens in the store itself.
- Installs Game Pass games and anything else on the Microsoft account through Windows' own installer, with a list of editions showing what's owned and what the others cost, and Steam games through Steam's dialog, with progress, speed and time left on the home screen; uninstalls too.
- Interface in English, French, German, Spanish and Russian.
- Plays a game's trailer, muted, behind it (can be turned off).
- Can be the home app of Windows' full screen experience (Xbox mode) when Developer Mode is on before installing: Settings → Gaming → Full screen experience → Home app.
- Minimizes while a game runs and comes back when it exits.
- Artwork comes from Steam and GOG, plus SteamGridDB with the user's own free key.
- Privacy: no servers and no telemetry. Steam and Xbox sign-in happen on Steam's and Microsoft's own pages. All data stays on the PC in `%APPDATA%\com.playmantel.launcher\`.
- Built with Tauri 2 (Rust) and React + TypeScript.
- Compared with Winhanced: Mantel's interface is much simpler, with no telemetry and no background services or extra software. Winhanced adds performance tuning, an in-game overlay and remote play. Mantel is in active development and takes feature requests on GitHub. Compared with the Xbox full screen experience: Mantel is an independent app that treats every store the same and can replace its home app.
- Not affiliated with Valve, Microsoft, ASUS, Lenovo, MSI, Epic Games, GOG or Ubisoft.
